command:
set -euo pipefail
PRE=$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}')
echo LIVE_SHA=$PRE
echo '=== ROLL STATE/TABLE ==='
grep -nE 'KOPF_ROLL_AUGEN_OFFSET|kopfRollWert|kopfRollAusgleichDeg|augenOffsetD[xy]|kopfRollTick|kopfKoerperDrehSchritt' buehne.html | head -n 160
echo '=== TRANSFORM CSS/DOM ==='
grep -nE '#kopf-dreh|#koerper-dreh|#augen|#augen-blink|#pupillen-glow|transform-origin|transform:' buehne.html | head -n 240
echo '=== EXACT FUNCTION WINDOWS ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('buehne.html').read_text(); lines=s.splitlines()
keys=['const KOPF_ROLL_AUGEN_OFFSET','function kopfRollTick','function kopfKoerperDrehSchritt','kopfRollAusgleichDeg =','augenOffsetDx =','kopfImg.style.transform','augen.style.transform','kopfDreh.style.transform']
seen=set()
for key in keys:
 for i,l in enumerate(lines):
  if key in l:
   a=max(0,i-10); b=min(len(lines),i+28); k=(a,b)
   if k in seen: continue
   seen.add(k); print(f'--- {key} @ {i+1} ---'); print('\n'.join(f'{j+1}:{lines[j]}' for j in range(a,b)))
PY
POST=$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}'); test "$POST" = "$PRE"; echo LIVE_POST_SHA=$POST; echo ROLL_EYE_TRANSFORM_CONTRACT_READ=PASS
